screensavers.title: Screensavers
screensavers.description: Choose a scene for quiet moments.
screensavers.shuffleHelp: Choose an available Aranea scene each time. Omarchy is excluded.
screensavers.previewHelp: Preview opens full screen. Move your pointer, click, or press a key to return.
screensavers.automaticMissing: Automatic activation is unavailable. Install or repair the Aranea session integration.
screensavers.timingHelp: Both times are measured from your last activity.
screensavers.invalidTiming: Enter whole minutes from 1 to 1440, or choose Disabled.
screensavers.invalidOrder: Lock must be later than the screensaver when both are enabled.
screensavers.stayAwake: Stay awake is on; automatic idle actions are paused.
screensavers.confirmationFailed: The result could not be confirmed. Review the current values and retry.
